crash.title: Minecraft Crash Analysis
crash.genericSuggestion: Export the crash report and inspect the complete logs for more context.

jvm_invalid_arguments.title: Invalid JVM arguments
suggestions: Remove recently added JVM arguments.
Make sure each argument is supported by the selected Java version.

memory_out_of_memory.title: Not enough available memory
suggestions: Increase game memory moderately or close memory-heavy applications.
If memory is already overallocated, lower it and inspect the mod set.

java_incompatible_version.title: Incompatible Java version
suggestions: Select the Java version required by this Minecraft and loader version.
Prefer a 64-bit HotSpot/OpenJDK distribution.

java_module_access.title: Java module access denied
suggestions: Switch to the Java version recommended for this instance.
Remove incompatible legacy loaders or core mods.

java_legacy_forge.title: Legacy Forge is incompatible with Java
suggestions: Use a compatible Java 8 build for legacy Forge.
Update Forge or the related launch component.

java_openj9.title: Unsupported Java VM
suggestions: Switch to a HotSpot-based Java distribution.
Rescan and select a compatible Java runtime.

java_32bit_heap.title: 32-bit Java memory limit
suggestions: Install and select 64-bit Java.
Temporarily lower allocated memory before switching.

java_architecture_mismatch.title: Java or native library architecture mismatch
suggestions: Use matching architectures for Java, the OS, and native libraries.
Delete the instance native cache and repair game files.

java_mac_jdk_legacy.title: Legacy JDK window issue on macOS
suggestions: Upgrade to a newer Java 8 build or later.
Update the launcher and Forge components, then retry.

graphics_opengl_unsupported.title: OpenGL is not supported
suggestions: Update the graphics driver and make the game use the discrete GPU.
Avoid remote desktop sessions without hardware acceleration.

graphics_driver_crash.title: Graphics driver crash
suggestions: Update or roll back to a stable graphics driver.
Temporarily disable shaders and graphics enhancement mods.

graphics_macos_glfw.title: macOS display service unavailable
suggestions: Make sure a display is connected and awake.
Update GPU drivers or switch to a compatible Java version.

graphics_rtss_sodium.title: RTSS is incompatible with Sodium
suggestions: Exit RivaTuner Statistics Server or disable its injection.
Add Sodium to the RTSS exclusion list or uninstall it.

jvm_native_crash.title: Native Java crash
suggestions: Inspect the problematic frame in the hs_err_pid log.
Change Java and update graphics drivers or native components.

native_library_missing.title: Native library missing or unloadable
suggestions: Repair the instance files and native libraries.
Check whether security software quarantined a DLL or shared library.

files_integrity_failure.title: Corrupted game files
suggestions: Repair the game and loader files.
Delete the damaged JAR named in the log and download it again.

files_already_exists.title: File already exists
suggestions: Delete the conflicting file named in the log and retry.
Check whether the instance directory was extracted or overwritten twice.

loader_install_incomplete.title: Incomplete mod loader installation
suggestions: Reinstall Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, or Quilt.
Ensure the version JSON and libraries were not modified manually.

loader_forge_error_screen.title: Forge reported an error and halted
suggestions: Check the exception listed in the evidence.
Fix or remove the related mods as suggested.

mod_extracted_jar.title: A mod was extracted incorrectly
suggestions: Remove extracted mod folders from the mods directory.
Keep only the original mod JAR files.

mod_duplicate.title: Duplicate mods detected
suggestions: Remove duplicate mod copies identified by the evidence.
Check for enabled and disabled copies of the same mod.

mod_missing_dependency.title: Missing mod dependency
suggestions: Install the dependency and version named in the log.
Match it to the current loader and Minecraft version.

mod_incompatible.title: Incompatible mod versions
suggestions: Remove conflicting mods or install compatible versions.
Follow the solution reported by the mod loader.

mod_class_resolution_failure.title: Class conflict or missing class
suggestions: Locate the mod by the class name in the evidence and update it.
Check for mods that do not match the game version.

mod_mixin_failure.title: Mixin injection failed
suggestions: Update the associated mod and its dependencies.
Disable recently added core or optimization mods in batches.

mod_mixin_bootstrap_missing.title: Mixin bootstrap is missing
suggestions: Repair the loader and library files.
Check that Mixin or Fabric versions match the game.

mod_config_failure.title: Invalid mod configuration
suggestions: Back up and remove the failing config so the mod can regenerate it.
Check for invalid manual edits.

mod_initialization_failure.title: Mod initialization failed
suggestions: Update or temporarily remove the mod shown in the evidence.
Verify its dependencies and loader version.

mod_loader_reported.title: The loader reported a mod failure
suggestions: Follow the solution reported in the loader log first.
Export the report to inspect the complete failure context.

mod_optifine_conflict.title: OptiFine or graphics mod conflict
suggestions: Temporarily remove OptiFine and retry.
Use a graphics optimization option compatible with this loader.

mod_optifine_duplicate.title: OptiFine installed twice
suggestions: Remove the OptiFine file from the mods folder and keep the built-in install.
Make sure OptiFine is not present as both a mod and a version component.

mod_id_limit_exceeded.title: Mod IDs exceeded the limit
suggestions: Remove some mods to reduce ID usage.
Upgrade to a game version with a higher ID limit.

mod_invalid_module_name.title: Invalid mod file name
suggestions: Rename the file using letters and numbers only.
Remove non-ASCII or special characters from the path.

resource_render_failure.title: Resource pack or render resource failure
suggestions: Disable recently added resource packs or shaders.
Lower resource resolution and inspect VRAM usage.

world_block_failure.title: A block in the world caused the crash
suggestions: Back up the save first.
Locate the block from the evidence and repair the chunk or related mod.

world_entity_failure.title: An entity in the world caused the crash
suggestions: Back up the save first.
Locate and remove the broken entity or its related mod.

game_manual_debug_crash.title: A debug crash was triggered
suggestions: Check whether the debug crash shortcut was pressed accidentally.
Inspect key mappings or automation if it was not intentional.

game_crash_report.title: Minecraft generated a crash report
suggestions: Review the other possible causes and evidence.
Export the complete report for further diagnosis.

stack_suspected_mod.title: The stack points to a suspected mod
suggestions: Update or temporarily remove the suspected mods.
If it persists, inspect related dependency mods in batches.

stack_suspected_component.title: The stack points to a third-party component
suggestions: Match the package names to installed mods or components.
Export the report and compare it with the mod list.

unknown_no_logs.title: No crash logs are available
suggestions: Launch again and wait for the crash report to finish writing.
Check log directory permissions and security software.

unknown_unclassified.title: The cause could not be classified
suggestions: Export the crash report and preserve the complete logs.
Undo the most recent changes and launch again.
